uic.common.cancel.description: Generic label of a button that backs out of an action or stops a task

uic.common.confirm.description: Generic label of a button that confirms an action

uic.common.delete.description: Generic label of a button that deletes something

uic.DeleteConfirmModal.title.description: Title of the dialog that confirms deleting one item

uic.DeleteConfirmModal.titleMany.defaultMessage: {count, plural, other {ลบ # รายการ}}
uic.DeleteConfirmModal.titleMany.description: Title of the dialog that confirms deleting several items; {count} is how many

uic.DeleteConfirmModal.description.defaultMessage: คุณแน่ใจหรือไม่ว่าต้องการลบ?
uic.DeleteConfirmModal.description.description: Question above the list of items about to be deleted

uic.DeleteConfirmModal.targetDescription.defaultMessage: คุณแน่ใจหรือไม่ว่าต้องการลบ {target} อย่างถาวร?
uic.DeleteConfirmModal.targetDescription.description: Question above the list of items about to be deleted; {target} names the kind of item, e.g. Project

uic.DeleteConfirmModal.typeToConfirm.defaultMessage: พิมพ์ {confirmText} เพื่อยืนยัน
uic.DeleteConfirmModal.typeToConfirm.description: Instruction above the confirmation field; {confirmText} is the text to type, shown as a token

uic.DeleteConfirmModal.confirmText.description: The word the user types to confirm deleting several items at once

uic.DeleteConfirmModal.cannotBeUndone.defaultMessage: การกระทำนี้ไม่สามารถยกเลิกได้
uic.DeleteConfirmModal.cannotBeUndone.description: Warning that the deletion is permanent

uic.NumberStepper.increase.description: Accessible name of the button that steps a number field up

uic.NumberStepper.decrease.description: Accessible name of the button that steps a number field down

uic.SelectionLabel.selectedCount.description: How many items are selected, e.g. rows of a table; {count} is the number

uic.SelectionLabel.clear.defaultMessage: ยกเลิกการเลือกทั้งหมด
uic.SelectionLabel.clear.description: Button that clears the whole selection

uic.UncontrolledInput.label.description: Hidden accessible name of an input whose caller gave it no label of its own
